title: Open Trestle Model Candidate Batch v2
description: Canonical syntax for untrusted model-proposed review candidates with a closed defect category and optional plain-text fix guidance. Validation does not create a finding or prove factual support, range validity, evidence authority, final severity, category accuracy, or fix correctness.

reference_id.description: Opaque host-issued reference copied from the model input allow-list.

source_range.description: A 1-based inclusive proposed range. Trusted admission must resolve the source and verify ordering and bounds.

title.description: Nonblank untrusted plain text without carriage returns or line feeds.

claim.description: Nonblank untrusted text. ASCII whitespace alone is not content.

category.description: Advisory defect category chosen from a closed set. It does not change verification or final severity.

fix.description: Optional nonblank untrusted plain-text fix guidance, at most 256 characters, which always fits the runtime's 1024-byte UTF-8 bound. It is never applied automatically, carries no executable authority, and is not independently verified.

severity_hint.description: Advisory severity only. A verifier assigns any final severity.

evidence_ids.description: Host-issued evidence references. Trusted admission must resolve every value against the request allow-list.

candidates.description: Untrusted candidate proposals. An empty array is a valid no-candidate response.
